lean.statement: theorem coefficientTensor_normalization_unit (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p) : ∀ n : ℕ, let S := finiteIntrinsicClosed l E X n let F := coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E X (Nat.le_refl n) let μ := (coefficientDerivedSystemEvaluationCalculus l E X).choose.quotientCalculus.tensor (Nat.le_refl n) let e := Adjunction.leftAdjointIdIso ((coefficientDerivedSystemEvaluationCalculus l E X).choose.quotientCalculus.adjunction (Nat.le_refl n)) (normalizedDVRResUnit l E X n) ∀ K M : normalizedDVRDerived l E X n, S.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (e.inv.app K) (e.inv.app M)) = e.inv.app (S.tensor.obj (K, M)) ≫ μ.hom.app (K, M)
